title: Multi-Factor Authentication Not Enforced
description: Authentication to sensitive services (such as VPN, webmail, remote access, administrative portals, or cloud consoles) relies on a password alone, without a second factor. This leaves accounts fully exposed to credential theft, phishing, password spraying, and reuse of breached credentials.
businessImpact: High --- without MFA, a single compromised password grants attacker access to the service, which is a leading cause of breaches.
remediation:
- Enforce phishing-resistant MFA (e.g., FIDO2/WebAuthn) for all remote access, administrative, and cloud accounts.
- Prioritize internet-facing and privileged access for immediate MFA rollout.
- Disable legacy authentication protocols that bypass MFA.
- Monitor and alert on MFA failures and anomalous sign-ins.
